info.title: dotnet-runic-toolkit
info.description: Coordinated development loop for native CS-WebUI RunicToolkit applications.

options.name: --project
options.description: Select a .csproj or a directory containing one.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration (default: Debug).

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Do not restore NuGet or npm dependencies.

options.name: --no-contracts
options.description: Do not generate or watch the configured contract.

options.name: --no-frontend-watch
options.description: Build once without starting the frontend watcher.

options.name: --no-dotnet-watch
options.description: Run the managed application once (useful for gates).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Evaluate and print the development configuration.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
The selected project supplies frontend paths through
optional RunicToolkit frontend-development MSBuild properties. The command generates and
verifies contracts, performs the initial build, starts the native CS-WebUI
host and frontend tooling. Projects that opt into Vite development-server
mode receive native-window CSS/JavaScript HMR without restarting .NET;
their private CS-WebUI bindings remain the application transport.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Doctor evaluates the selected application and reports actionable PASS,
WARN, and FAIL checks for the .NET SDK, optional Node/package-manager
toolchain, native CS-WebUI library, browser, lock file, Vite entry/config,
and generated contracts. A report with any FAIL result exits with code 1.
